name: Final Sorceress death
doc: Final Sorceress death (enemy attack 328): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag207_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - the caster's model melting into the ground while a palette shifted through its hues tints the battle. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag208_final_sorceress_death.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.
